- Build a complete, playable browser-based “hajwala” 3D drifting game for phones and tablets.

- Support mobile touch controls and responsive layouts.
- Make reasonable assumptions without clarification.
- For visual checks, save JPEG screenshots no wider than 1280px and inspect only the latest.

- Implemented an arcade drift game using Three.js, with a desert oval circuit, scoring, HUD, keyboard and touch controls, and pause/audio controls.
- Disabled real-time shadows and instanced repeated scenery to reduce rendering overhead.
